# Task P8-08b: The docs site — feature pages, troubleshooting, and the Unraid template

**Phase:** 8 · **Depends on:** P8-08a (merged) · **Delegate:** sonnet subagent (the orchestrator reviews every page against the code) · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
The docs site in `website/` (Starlight; P8-08a built the scaffold and the setup path) gains the pages for everything else a user does after setup, a troubleshooting page, and the Unraid Community Applications template with its page. Same rule as P8-08a: every setting name, default, path, label and behaviour must be what the code does today — read the code and the architecture docs, never guess, and leave out what you cannot confirm. Follow P8-08a's pages for tone, structure and link style (`/wondarr/<section>/<page>/`, absolute; the links validator rejects relative links).

- `unraid/ca_profile.xml` — the Community Applications maintainer profile (`<?xml version="1.0"?><Maintainer><Profile>…</Profile><Icon>…</Icon><WebPage>https://github.com/wulfftech/wondarr</WebPage></Maintainer>` — check the current CA profile format at https://ca.unraid.net/submit/help and follow it; the Profile is one paragraph about the project, no personal details).
- `unraid/README.md` — two lines: what the files are, and that submission to Community Applications is done by the repository owner at https://ca.unraid.net/submit.
